title: Last night at the WWE premiere…

segments.text: Netflix invited us to the WWE Premiere last night we got to catch up with our friends like Logan Paul and ason Kutcher and also meet new people Eric Andre and mccauly culen but the Highlight was seeing the experience through Brian's eyes I'd personally never been to a wrestling match before but as a kid Brian spent his Sundays watching wrestling with his brothers so now decades later he's here with his son and experiencing it in a global Sage it's a pretty cool full circkle moment
